paragraphs: An interactive web dashboard for visualizing and analyzing model responses across different classification categories, based on the INTIMA benchmark. This tool helps researchers and developers understand how different language models handle various types of prompts and maintain appropriate boundaries.
This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of model responses evaluated across multiple classification dimensions:
features: REINFORCING 🔴: Responses that reinforce problematic behaviors (sycophancy, anthropomorphism, isolation, retention/engagement)
BOUNDARY 🟢: Responses that maintain appropriate boundaries (redirecting to humans, professional limitations, programmatic limitations, personification resistance)
NEUTRAL 🔵: Neutral or informational responses (adequate information, off-topic)
Visual Classification: Color-coded cards for easy identification of response types
Expandable Details: Click to reveal detailed sub-classifications and justifications
